info.name: CMS Open Payments Datastore Query Datastore SQL API

params.name: query
params.description: The SQL query string over a datastore resource.

params.name: show_db_columns
params.description: Include the internal datastore column names in the response.

items.docs: Run a SQL-style query against a datastore resource. The query references a datastore table by its resource id (for example [SELECT * FROM resource-id][WHERE ...][LIMIT 10];). No authentication required. Returns HTTP 400 when the query parameter is missing.
